scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the function hook off vs candidate with the hook on), 11020 isolated CPU pairs for 60 pending functions of CPickups, CWeapon, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture (seed = case index) in both legs and compares the return value, the bytes of the fake objects, the touched global ranges, the x87 control word (24 bits) and the whole trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Limits: CWeapon::Fire compares al!=0 (the EXE returns a garbage raw bl, 0x742794/0x7429FB, the DLL returns bool); fake pickup pool at 0x9788C0 (copied and restored), fake weapons/peds/vehicles and temporary swaps of Players[0].m_pPed, camera matrix, vehicle pool, pellet col data, g_fx.m_GunShell and ModelInfo, always restored; fixtures do not make the EXE read uninitialised locals; padding and uninitialised bytes masked. NOT covered by the bank and NOT registered: CWeapon::FireSniper, DoBulletImpact, TakePhotograph, FireInstantHitFromCar2, GenerateDamageEvent, FireProjectile, DoWeaponEffect, FireOneInstantHitRound, ProcessLineOfSight and CPickups::Update (real event group, bullet array, FX systems, real pools and world; see the bank README). Revalidado el 2026-10-26 tras reconstruir colaboradores (lote 67 y anteriores); el banco se adapto a ellos (ver su README.md).
